title: Milei Tells UN General Assembly Its 'Sacred Covenant Has Been Broken,' Renews Falklands Claim
detail: Addressing the UN General Assembly in New York, President Milei said the United Nations had broken the 'sacred covenant' on which it was founded, calling it a 'useless organization' for failing to prevent chaos and violence while sheltering dictatorships. He reframed the Falklands/Malvinas dispute as a 'national cause,' arguing that self-determination does not apply because the islands' population was 'implanted' by an occupying power, and said the lack of enforcement of a 50-year-old UN resolution showed 'what is lacking is consequences.' Milei also condemned Iranian attacks on Israel, declared Argentina had 'unequivocally aligned' with the West, the US, and Israel, and called for AI regulation to stay minimal, proposing limited liability for AI firms and tax incentives.

title: Milei Meets Rubio at UNGA Amid Falklands/Malvinas Diplomatic Row with UK
detail: President Javier Milei held a bilateral meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, as Argentina was engaged in a public diplomatic row with UK Prime Minister over Falklands/Malvinas sovereignty. The meeting underscored Argentina's effort to shore up U.S. support for its longstanding territorial claim.
